options.planned_success: Use the sliced weight for successful prints
options.planned_progress: Sliced weight, × progress for failed/cancelled prints

get_history.name: Get print history
get_history.description: Returns the past prints recorded by this integration (cost, energy, filament, per-spool detail) with totals.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: 3D Print Cost entry to use. Optional when only one printer is configured.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of prints, newest first.

estimate_cost.name: Estimate cost of a G-code
estimate_cost.description: Estimates the total cost of a sliced .gcode or .gcode.3mf file before printing it, from the slicer estimates, Spoolman prices and the average power of past prints.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: 3D Print Cost entry to use. Optional when only one printer is configured.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Path of the .gcode or .gcode.3mf file, e.g. /media/prints/cube.gcode.3mf. Must be in an allowed folder (/media or /config/www by default).

plate.name: Plate
plate.description: Plate to estimate when the .3mf contains several sliced plates.

spool_ids.name: Spoolman spool IDs
spool_ids.description: One Spoolman spool ID per filament of the plate, in slicer order. Without it, the spool loaded in the AMS with the same material and colour is used.

power_w.name: Average power
power_w.description: Average printer power. Defaults to the average measured on past successful prints.

entry_not_found.message: No 3D Print Cost entry with id {entry_id}.

no_entry.message: No 3D Print Cost printer is loaded.

several_entries.message: Several printers are configured: choose one with config_entry_id.

path_not_allowed.message: Access to {path} is not allowed. Put the file in /media or /config/www, or add its folder to allowlist_external_dirs.
